# Two windows resolving to the same output path must error out.

! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out site.sngl
stderr 'window output path collision'

-- site.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

output { none { html } }

component main root {
    window #a(title="A", href="/dup.html") { text(value="a") }
    window #b(title="B", href="/dup.html") { text(value="b") }
}

main()
